title: Content Culture Picker: Let Visitors Switch Languages | Orchard Core
description:
A site with content in several languages needs a way for visitors to choose one, and to land on the right page when they do.

The Content Culture Picker adds a language menu to the navigation bar of the site. When a visitor picks a language, the picker opens the same page in that language, opens the homepage in that language, or keeps the visitor on the page.

In this video:
• How the picker works, and what it relies on
• Enabling the Content Culture Picker feature
• Switching languages on the site
• A page without a translation
• Homepage redirect
• The language cookie, and who can change the settings
